2607.00272.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
2607.00272.paper_summary: Traditional robot programming is challenging: it requires orchestrating multimodal perception, managing physical contact dynamics, and handling diverse configurations and execution failures. We introduce ASPIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library. ASPIRE discovers skills that persist across tasks, simulation and real-world settings, and embodiments. It operates in an open-ended loop with three components: (1) a closed-loop robot execution engine that exposes fine-grained multimodal traces, enabling autonomous failure diagnosis, repair synthesis, and validation; (2) a continually expanding skill library that distills validated fixes into reusable, transferable knowledge; and (3) evolutionary search that generates diverse task sequences and control programs to explore beyond single-trajectory refinement. ASPIRE surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on LIBERO-Pro manipulation under perturbation, 72% on Robosuite bimanual handover, and 32% on BEHAVIOR-1K long-horizon household tasks. Its accumulated library also enables zero-shot generalization to unseen long-horizon tasks: on LIBERO-Pro Long, ASPIRE achieves 31% success versus 4% for prior methods despite their use of test-time reasoning and retries. Finally, simulation-discovered skills provide initial evidence of sim-to-real transfer, substantially reducing real-robot programming effort across different embodiments and robot APIs.
2607.00272.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的機器人編程具有挑戰性：它需要協調多模態感知、管理物理接觸動力學，以及處理多樣的配置和執行失敗。我們介紹了ASPIRE（透過迭代機器人探索的代理技能編程），這是一個持續學習系統，能夠自主編寫和完善機器人控制程序，採用代碼作為政策的範式，同時將經驗積累到可重用的技能庫中。ASPIRE發現跨任務、模擬和現實世界環境及具身體的持久技能。它在一個開放式循環中運作，包含三個組件：（1）一個封閉循環的機器人執行引擎，能夠暴露細粒度的多模態痕跡，從而實現自主故障診斷、修復合成和驗證；（2）一個不斷擴展的技能庫，將經過驗證的修復提煉成可重用的、可轉移的知識；以及（3）進化搜索，生成多樣的任務序列和控制程序，以探索超越單一軌跡的精煉。ASPIRE在LIBERO-Pro擾動下的操作超越了先前的方法，提升了77%，在Robosuite雙手交接上提升了72%，在BEHAVIOR-1K長期家庭任務上提升了32%。其累積的庫也使得對未見的長期任務實現零-shot泛化：在LIBERO-Pro Long上，ASPIRE的成功率為31%，而先前的方法僅為4%，儘管它們使用了測試時推理和重試。最後，模擬發現的技能提供了模擬到現實轉移的初步證據，顯著減少了在不同具身和機器人API上的實際機器人編程工作。
